notes.title: Patch 0.1.3 - Difficulty Balancing
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your reviews, comments and forums posts, this is exactly why we launched into Early Access and we're excited to bring you the 3rd patch since release on Jan 24th!

This time we've made some tweaks to the difficulty in response to comments that some of you were getting GOT a LOT! 

This includes changes to the ambient sanity drain, the speed and frequency of the doll spawning and how fast the Safe Rooms activate. Full notes are below:

[h1]Patch 0.1.3 [/h1]
[h2][b]SANITY[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Lowered ambient sanity drain values throughout most of the game - Majority of player feedback was that the ambient sanity drain wasn’t providing interesting moments. So we’d like to focus on the dolls being the primary source of sanity drain.
[*] Increased ambient sanity drain after 500 seconds - This is to help bring the game to natural end and to reduce the effectiveness of hiding in a corner desperately cranking music boxes!
[*] Decreased doll sanity drain multiplier as the match progresses - There was an unwanted compound effect of increasing the number of dolls and making them drain more sanity, so we’re reducing that a bit to give you all more of a chance!
[/list]

[h2][b]SAFE ROOM[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Opens quicker across most player counts
[*] With 3 players, now randomly chooses between 1 and 2 saferoom capacity, as opposed to 1 maximum.
[/list]

[h2][b]DOLLS[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced doll spawn at immediate start of the game - This is to give players a little bit of breathing room to get their bearings.
[*] Slower increase of dolls spawning in the early half of a round - A lot of players were getting got, quite early on. So the dolls are going to wait a bit, to give you all a chance! 😉
[*] More dolls towards the later half of a round - The later a game gets, the more difficult it should be. Most players don’t and won’t last this long!
[/list]

[h2][b]FOOTSTEPS[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Sound range increased from 12 to 18m for running to encourage more careful movement around the school.
[/list]

Our previous patch notes can be read here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3467390/announcements/detail/498312073043771594]Patch 0.1.2 - Quality of Life Update[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3467390/announcements/detail/498311439425995822]Patch 0.1.1 - Bug fixes[/url]

We are working on more quality of life improvements and features, and we encourage you to share any suggestions or feedback with us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3467390/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url] or using any of the links below. 👀

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 - WE TURNED DOWN THE SHAKING SCREENS!
notes.notes:
We’re a week into our Early Access release, and already taking your feedback on board to improve the game for a more enjoyable experience. 

We’ve focused on immediate quality of life improvements such as Sanity FX, accessibility improvements, implementing Streamer Mode, and more. THANK YOU to the community for your support!

[h2][b]SANITY FX[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] In the settings menu, use the effects slider to reduce or increase these effects to your preferences
[*] The player’s screens will now turn red when sanity levels are low to replace the camera shake
[*] We’ve reduced the maximum Sanity FX when at low sanity or near a Doll
[/list]

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMnVuem5iaGpuZXJ1cXp1dXB4aDk3enZnbWE5bm0zZGJwZ2xjZ25wbiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/a5dYPS1E6MLdilR2I4/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458582/929938dad3c4dd50db5d17d7cf8016b819e8b22c.png[/img]

[h2][b]STREAMER MODE[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] We want our players to feel safe while playing online! Players can now toggle Streamer Mode on or off to hide everyone’s names for a more comfortable gaming experience. Although, we can’t save you from the Dolls…
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458582/1422a2a92d4e0978ad08350e2840543f0802b73b.png[/img]

[h2][b]ACCESSIBILITY IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] When looking at another player, their display names will pop up above their heads (so you know whose body you’ll be looting for key codes)
[*] Player name tags are no longer distorted by depth of field effects
[*] Added a game instructions page in the main menu
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458582/a94ecd09211e25d619068935fbfe5ecad38fb594.png[/img]

[h2][b]MISC & BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted grammar on hint text
[*] Added a version number and build number onscreen – This is mostly to help us developers match any future player issues with which version of the game people are running.
[*] Fixed an issue where the depth of field was stuck on in Spectator mode, if you died with your Scanner out. 

We’d love to hear from you! Let us know how we can further improve the game, and let us know if there’s any settings or creatures you’d like to see added to the game! We might look into it 👀
[/list]

notes.title: First update is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458582/858dc0eed2054103176be9d1386730b0a7e89e4a.png[/img]

It has been a wild 24 hours since we released the very first early version of the game for you to enjoy, test and give us some direction on where the game should head towards in the next few weeks. Just 24 hours and we're already updating the game! Yes, here's a brand new update with some significant fixes and tweaks -- thanks to your feedback!

[list]
[*] Host migration implemented. If the host player quits, the game ensures someone else takes over seamlessly, meaning the game doesn't end, it carries on normally.

[*] On the Private Rooms, we removed the characters 0 and O from the 4 letters code as the font made them look quite alike, making it hard for you to figure out which character to use.

[*] Players joining midway an ongoing game could get stuck (and alive) in the basketball court, essentially blocking matches from finishing. This has been fixed.- Some matches had positional voice chat disabled. This caused players to not be able to talk or hear one another, essentially draining the game from its social dynamics. This is now hopefully fixed.

[*]Added photosensitivity notice at the main menu to warn people that this is a dark game with players carrying flashlights... What could possibly go wrong, right?

[*] A bunch of smaller bugs and tweaks as reported by the players.
[/list]
We have a lot more in the works for next week. Once the game has the major bugs and tweaks behind it, we'll do a balance pass (yes, we know it's hard... But should it be easier?) and move to new content afterwards.Thanks for all the feedback! Hope you escape the dolls!!!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458582/26c641c04d237b6b432a19e6e1c8274dd2ad1540.png[/img]
